title: Billing and collections
subtitle: Track invoice totals, what was collected, and cash still outstanding to collect. Billing is not a quote.
statutoryDisclosure: Internal billing tracking only — not statutory invoice issuance.

list.emptyBody: Record billing when you send an amount to a client — even if the legal invoice lives in another system.

aging.title: Receivables aging
aging.note: Aging uses outstanding to collect only. Invoice totals include VAT if entered — VAT is not revenue for profit. Foreign-currency records are excluded.

receivables.title: Receivables summary
receivables.integrityNote: Outstanding to collect = Invoice total − Paid. Includes VAT if entered. Credit notes reduce outstanding; voided records and voided payments are excluded. VAT is not profit or revenue.
receivables.overdueCount: {count, plural, =0 {No overdue records} =1 {# overdue record} other {# overdue records}}
receivables.retentionReleaseHint: Shown only for finalized retention_release billing. Holdback accounting is not modeled separately.
receivables.excludedForeign: {count, plural, =1 {# open record excluded (foreign currency)} other {# open records excluded (foreign currency)}}

paymentHistory.title: Payment history
paymentHistory.subtitle: Payments applied to billing records. A payment is not a billing record.

integrity.creditNoteReducesInvoiced: Credit notes reduce invoice totals; they are not revenue for profit.
integrity.voidExcluded: Voided billing records and voided payments are excluded from invoice total, Paid, and outstanding to collect.

form.title: New billing record
form.moreDetailsHint: External document links and linked approved changes can be added in a later step.

retention.title: Retention / holdback
retention.disclosure: Retention is cash timing, not a second revenue. Invoiced / recognized stays the full billing amount; only receivable now is reduced until release.
retention.percentHint: Optional. 10 means 10% of the billing total.
retention.captureHint: Set amount or percent on a draft. On finalize, held remaining equals retention. After finalize, increase only with a new billing record.
retention.releaseHint: Partial release is allowed while held remaining is greater than zero. Releases are immutable history — not a second invoice.
retention.noneHeld: No retention is held on this billing record.

paymentForm.title: Record payment
paymentForm.splitHint: One payment can be allocated across finalized invoices of the same client. Unapplied remainder is allowed.

confirm.finalizeConsequence: Once finalized it cannot be edited.
confirm.voidRecordConsequence: It will be removed from Invoiced totals and cannot be restored.
confirm.voidPaymentConsequence: This creates a reversal entry and cannot be undone.

panel.emptyBody: Record billing when you charge the client for work on this project.
panel.integrityHint: Credit notes reduce invoice totals. Voided records are excluded from totals. Invoice total is not revenue for profit.

errors.notEditable: Only draft billing records can be edited.
errors.notFinalizable: Only draft billing records can be finalized.
errors.notVoidable: Only finalized billing records can be voided.
errors.correctionNotVoidable: Correcting entries cannot be voided again.
errors.paymentTargetNotFinalized: Payments can only be recorded against finalized billing records.
errors.paymentNotVoidable: Only recorded payments can be voided.
errors.currencyMismatch: Billing currency must match the project currency.
errors.hasRecordedPayments: Void recorded payments before voiding this billing record.
errors.paymentOverApplied: Payment would exceed receivable now (after retention held).
errors.paymentTargetCreditNote: Payments cannot be recorded against credit notes.
errors.paymentClientMismatch: Payment client must match each invoice client.
errors.paymentCurrencyMismatch: Payment currency must match each invoice currency.
errors.paymentDuplicateInvoice: The same invoice cannot be applied twice in one payment.
errors.applicationsExceedPayment: Allocated amounts exceed the payment amount.
errors.retentionExceedsTotal: Retention cannot exceed the billing total.
errors.retentionCannotIncrease: Retention cannot be increased after finalize; record a new billing record.
errors.retentionNotReleasable: Retention can only be released after the billing record is finalized.
errors.retentionReleaseDateFuture: Release date cannot be in the future.

notAllowed.title: Not allowed
notAllowed.body: You do not have permission to view billing and collections.
